title: Listening Drill — Introductory pottery — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Introductory pottery — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on introductory pottery last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with cracked bowl. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: uneven firing.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of wall thickness so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow clay sample instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the studio tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Wednesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
